instruction_text: Speak directly to one listener with warmth and a smile in your voice; calm, steady and reassuring, like a favorite morning radio host, while keeping the news clear and credible.
asr_text: Won't attack. When you hear those words, you may already be ending the meeting in your mind. You may think, so Britain will only defend. But wait, one important detail is missing from the meeting notes. Who will not attack? This time, the news detective must find the subject. First, let's look at the announcement. A spokesperson for the Saudi-led coalition forces in Yemen said they had stopped and destroyed one ballistic missile the Houthis had fired at toward Riyadh. In this case, the UK Ministry of Defence announced an air defence mission for Royal Air Force Typhoon fighter jets. They will protect Saudi cities and important sites from air attacks. Their mission is only to defend. The jets will not attack the Houthis.
